title: Sonochemical Synthesis of Nanocrystalline Silver Tellurides Ag2Te and Ag7Te4

paper.title: Sonochemical Synthesis of Nanocrystalline Silver Tellurides Ag2Te and Ag7Te4
paper.authors: Bin Li; Yi Xie; Yu Liu; Jiaxing Huang; Yitai Qian

supporting_information.note: No SI document or SI values imported.

independent_audit: PASS WITH LIMITS — All four supplied main-paper pages and XRD/TEM Figures 1–2 independently quick-audited. The two solvent/charge routes and panel assignments were accepted; no SI was used. No measured atomic-coordinate or exact physical-batch claim is admitted.

figures.caption_paraphrase: XRD patterns: panel A is monoclinic Ag2Te and panel B is hexagonal Ag7Te4.
figures.sample_scope: Panels identify products by composition and solvent route; the paper does not state the Figure 1 and Figure 2 panels are identical physical batches.
gaps: No measured atomic positions, cell occupancy, uncertainty or crystallite-size distribution provided.

figures.label: Figure 2
source_locators: Main PDF p.3 / printed 262, Figure 2 caption
figures.caption_paraphrase: TEM micrographs: panel A Ag2Te in ethylenediamine, panel B Ag7Te4 in ethanol; panels have different scale bars.
figures.sample_scope: Approximate spherical particles appear in aggregates; about 20 nm Ag2Te and about 50 nm Ag7Te4 are stated in p.2 Results. Do not use a common pixel calibration across panels.
quantitative_facts: Ag2Te about 20 nm; Ag7Te4 about 50 nm.
gaps: No histogram, count, standardized shape descriptor, or proof that XRD and TEM are same physical batches.

chemical_intuition.statement: The authors propose that ethylenediamine coordination and higher viscosity restrain Ag2Te particle growth relative to ethanol, alongside different solvent reducing properties. These are mechanistic interpretations, not separately quantified causal effects.

chemical_intuition.statement: Low-intensity or absent sonication gave no detectable reaction by XRD even after prolonged periods; exact control intensity and exposure times are not stated.

source_locators.locator: Main PDF p.3 / printed 262, Results and Discussion, sonication-control paragraph

chemical_intuition.statement: Tellurium can form a transient sonicated ethylenediamine solution, later releasing about 25 nm by 100 nm Te nanorods; this is a mechanistic side experiment, not a silver telluride recipe–structure pair.

source_locators.locator: Main PDF p.3 / printed 262, Results and Discussion, tellurium side experiment

unresolved: Ethanol route is described by substitution in the typical procedure; the paper does not separately list its reactor-fill or probe settings. They are carried as inherited conditions, not direct ethanol-specific measurements.
No exact solvent aliquot, filter type, washing cycles, pressure, atmosphere, yield, atomic coordinates or ligand/surface analysis reported.
Source uses 20 ± 5 °C as bulk solution temperature; high cavitation temperatures discussed conceptually are not reactor set points.
